summary: A granular sampler firmware that turns a few seconds of any sample into moving clouds, loops and swells, played from the FM-1's keys and knobs.
features: Six modes: CLOUD, DUST, TAPE, BLOOM, PULSE and DRIFT
Keys play the grains at any pitch with velocity; chords work
Held FX plus black keys: freeze, reverse, stutter, tape stop, shimmer
RANDOM with knob locks and undo; RESAMPLE records up to five seconds
14 CC0 factory sounds, 16 user slots, 21 to 62 s total
Follows MIDI clock start, stop and tempo; does not read other firmwares' samples
